pages.text: $(thing)APRS$() sends short packets over a VHF radio: position beacons, messages and digipeats.$(li)The $(item)Radio Interface$() touches the radio and holds the call sign and the TX switch.$(li)The $(item)H19 terminal$() touches the interface (or another terminal): beacons, the station list and messages.

pages.name: APRS station
pages.text: Base station, Radio Interface, H19, Transfer Interface, and a J-pole.

The H19's screen says READY, CONTACT when a new station is heard and MSG when a message arrives.$(br2)Right click it with an $(item)empty map$() for an $(thing)APRS map$() of the stations heard. Sneak with 4 or 9 maps for a 2x2 or 3x3 map wall.
